plan.title: RFQ bid refused after countdown ends

steps.note: Start an eRFX create flow for the RFQ event.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product needed for the vendor bid sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so publishing can proceed.
Commit the shortest supported bidding window; the exact one-minute duration is unavailable.
Invite the vendor named in the case.
Publish the RFQ so Vendor A can open it in the supplier portal.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the separate supplier session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the live RFQ bid sheet as Vendor A before the countdown ends.
Return to the buyer session to wait for the event to close.
Wait for the bidding window to end naturally while the vendor sheet remains open.
Return to Vendor A's bid sheet after the countdown has ended.
Try to submit a bid after expiry and require positive evidence that the portal refuses it or keeps submission disabled.
